Post-call recap & proposed MAP

Alex

thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

Pain points / goals we heard:
- Current inference costs for clinical summarization pipelines are unpredictable; spikes during batch jobs drive up monthly spend.
- Latency sensitivity on live clinician UI (95th percentile target <= 150ms).
- Compliance: need audit logs, KMS integration, and SOC2 evidence for PHI processing.

Primary stakeholders you mentioned:
- Alex Johnson (Director of ML) evaluation lead
- Sanjay Patel (VP Engineering) infra & rollout decision-maker
- Procurement (procurement@novushealth.com) contact

Proposed MAP (high level)

— milestones, owners, target dates:
1) Technical POC: demo + 2-week POC using sample dataset (Redwood + Novus dev env)

— Owner: Camila / Alex 

Target: 2027-05-24
2) Security review & evidence collection (SOC2, KMS docs) 

— Owner: Vivek 
Target: 2027-05-28
3) Pricing & contract terms draft 
— Owner: Camila / Procurement 
Target: 2027-06-04
4) Pilot launch (limited live traffic, SLA review) 
— Owner: Novus Eng / Redwood CS 
Target: 2027-06-18

Next steps I'll take:
- Share a MAP spreadsheet and a quick pricing overview (attached).
- Schedule a 30m POC kickoff with your ML + infra team with Marissa and Vivek.

Can you confirm the owners and preferred kickoff date? If anything above is missing or incorrect, please flag.

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Redwood_Pricing_Overview.pdf

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

this is perfect, thanks for the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- POC scope: we want to validate both latency on the clinician UI (95th <=150ms) and cost/unit for our nightly summarization batch (we'll provide a sample of recent job sizes).
- Security: Sanjay will lead the security checklist; he specifically called out end-to-end encryption at rest, KMS integration, and retention policies for audit logs.
- Procurement: procurement@novushealth.com is the right contact for commercial terms; they usually need 2 weeks to review an initial SOW.

Preferred POC kickoff: Thu 5/20 at 10:00am PT works for our ML/infra team.

Also, please include any required SOC2 artifacts and a short runbook for the POC.

Thanks Alex
